role: Speculative enquiry: graduate site or project engineer (Derrimut)
subject: Career Opportunity: speculative enquiry, graduate site or project engineer, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Western Civil team,

This is a speculative expression of interest, sent because your careers page invites graduate engineers to send a resume to this address. I'm looking for a graduate site or project engineer place.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, documented in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. In 2019 and 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, handling site inspections, quality checks, materials tracking and progress reports. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.

Your land development team self-performs earthworks, pavements and stormwater drainage on industrial and residential subdivisions, which is the work I trained for, and Derrimut is close to home. I haven't yet worked on an Australian construction site, so I would start under supervision.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate site or project engineer role, or be open to a short chat? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

• How did you find us? → Your advert for the Speculative enquiry: graduate site or project engineer (Derrimut) role on SEEK.
• They may ask about: No advertised vacancy → answer honestly from the facts; nothing beyond them was claimed.
• They may ask about: No Australian construction site experience → answer honestly from the facts; nothing beyond them was claimed.
• They may ask about: No paid civil design role yet → answer honestly from the facts; nothing beyond them was claimed.
• What are your work rights? → Subclass 485 visa, full working rights until December 2027.
• Tell me about your site experience. → About a year in the Philippines, 2019 to 2020: project-in-charge on a community hall renovation (10 to 15 workers a day, drawing reviews, inspections, quality checks), then field engineer on subdivision finishing works (site reports, material records, procurement, coordinating with engineers and suppliers).
• What did you study in Australia? → Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, Albright Institute, February 2024 to February 2026: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, Before You Dig Australia enquiries.

• Do you have a licence, White Card, transport? → Yes to all three; also a Working with Children Check.
